component.name: DetailPanel
component.script:
sub init() m.top.panelSize = "wide" m.top.focusable = true m.inner = m.top.findNode("inner") c = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to 2 c.createChild("ContentNode").title = "detail " + i.toStr() end for m.inner.content = c m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onFocus") end sub
sub onFocus() pc = m.global.probeCase if pc = "chainGate" ' Gates the forward on isInFocusChain() instead of hasFocus(), a common app pattern. plog("act", "details notified hasFocus=" + m.top.hasFocus().toStr() + " inChain=" + m.top.isInFocusChain().toStr()) if m.top.isInFocusChain() and m.top.focusedChild <> invalid and m.top.focusedChild.isSameNode(m.top) m.inner.setFocus(true) end if return end if if not m.top.hasFocus() then return plog("act", "details gained -> " + pc + " inChain=" + m.top.isInFocusChain().toStr()) if pc = "forward" m.inner.setFocus(true) else if pc = "bounce" ' Signal the screen, which unfocuses this panel and refocuses the menu (field observer). m.top.backPressed = true else if pc = "bounceDirect" m.top.setFocus(false) r = m.top.menuRef.setFocus(true) plog("act", "menu.setFocus returned " + r.toStr()) else if pc = "noUnfocus" r = m.top.menuRef.setFocus(true) plog("act", "menu.setFocus returned " + r.toStr()) end if end sub
